mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_company (company_code, company_name, ceo_name, business_type) VALUES (#{companyCode}, #{companyName}, #{ceoName}, #{businessType})
mapper.select: SELECT company_code AS companyCode, company_name AS companyName, ceo_name AS ceoName, business_type AS businessType, regdate, updatedate AS updateDate FROM tbl_company WHERE company_name = #{companyName}

SELECT company_code AS companyCode, company_name AS companyName, ceo_name AS ceoName, business_type AS businessType, regdate, updatedate AS updateDate FROM tbl_company WHERE
company_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY regdate DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_company SET ceo_name = #{ceoName}, business_type = #{businessType}, updatedate = SYSDATE WHERE company_name = #{companyName}
